text: Moms, never mix baking soda with these 3 things unless you're ready to buy a whole new wardrobe. Watch till the end. This was me before at my heaviest, and this is me now. No crazy diets, no expensive programs, just this. 1 is lemon, 2 is ice, and 3 is the one every version online leaves out. I kept seeing this all over my feed and every version skipped the 3rd ingredient. Then my sister sent me the one with the real ratio. Keto, low-carb, pink salt, fasting— none of it stuck. But this? Pound after pound, week after week, and it stayed off. My cravings quieted down and my jeans went from tight to comfortable to falling off. My sister didn't recognize me at Thanksgiving. Now she makes it every night too. Takes less than a minute with 3 things already in my kitchen, and it costs about $2, so nobody's ever going to run a commercial for it.
